packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 breaks ESLint: typescript-eslint peers `typescript: >=4.8.4 <6.1.0` and hard-throws on TS 7, which takes the whole lint step down. Revisit when typescript-eslint ships support for TS 7.1.
next and eslint-config-next must move together - the config's peer range is tied to the framework version.
The React runtime and the Testing Library packages must move together.
The Tailwind packages must move together.
The Node type definitions must track the Node version the project pins in .nvmrc.
Vitest and its plugins must move together.
